final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), ratios AS (SELECT sex, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS ratio FROM sex_counts), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.sex, r.record_count, r.ratio, r.record_count - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a WHERE r.record_count > a.avg_ratio
